# Pydantic error types a write body can still be answered with in the
# library's own English. Each is a "wrong JSON type" shape: an API client can
# send it, a screen cannot, because a form hands over the type its field
# declares. Goal: empty. A constraint type (a bound, a length, a digit count)
# must never appear here — it reaches a reader typing a correct-looking value.
bool_type
date_from_datetime_inexact
date_type
datetime_type
decimal_type
dict_type
float_type
int_type
list_type
model_attributes_type
model_type
string_type
url_type
uuid_type
# A constraint, still open: a URL longer than the schema's maximum.
url_too_long
# A list shorter or longer than its schema allows (storage hierarchy, reprint).
too_long
too_short
